title: Brief History of Portland Works
version: History of Portland Works and R. F. Mosley business
lineage: Paraphrased research notes, not a source copy.

passages.note: Friends of Portland Works describes R. F. Mosley’s cutlery business, its Portland Works site from 1879, and 1914 stainless cutlery work by manager Ernest Stuart with Harry Brearley. This is a retrospective account and its priority claims are not adopted.
